stem: Two concentrated fertilizer components are combined directly and a visible precipitate forms before final dilution. What is the strongest response?
choices: Apply the mixture because precipitation proves the nutrients are concentrated
Increase agitation and assume all precipitated material will remain plant-available
Stop and verify compatible mixing and dilution procedures before using the solution, because precipitation can remove ions from the dissolved nutrient supply
Correct only the final pH and ignore the precipitate
rationale: Some concentrated fertilizer components can react and precipitate when combined improperly. Mixing and dilution procedures should prevent incompatible concentrates from forming insoluble compounds before application.
